thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-98231 fired for service=redwood-runtime pool=gpu-pool-a severity=P1 — CUDA alloc failures / OOM rate spike detected. Logs: 
```
GPU_ALLOC_FAIL count=142 window=60s pool=gpu-pool-a err=CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY nvml_free=120MB
kvcache_evictions=320 prefetched=failed
```
PagerDuty: Incident PD-98231 created and paged schedule=oncall-eng. Details posted.

Alex Chen: Acking — oncall here. seeing repeated `cudaMalloc` failures on nodes gpu-a[03-06]. pulling logs now.

Priya Reddy: on it, checking tracing. Is this across all model sizes or one specific runner?

Samir Patel: looks concentrated on p80-runner (long-context chat) — memory usage growing continuously, nvml reports fragmentation. Could be kvcache growth + prefetch.

Lee (oncall): Confirmed customer-facing error spike: 5xx rate on /v1/generate up from 0.8% -> 9% last 5m for hosted region-us-west. Not widespread but several larger customers hit.

Maria S.: Copy. Any quick mitigations? Can we route to dedicated cpu-fallback pool or smaller model?

Alex Chen: Immediate mitigations: 1) disable KV prefetch on pool-a, 2) reroute canary traffic to cpu-fallback, 3) scale up small-quant models on other pools. Applying step 1 now.

Priya Reddy: Command I ran: `rlctl pool update gpu-pool-a --kv-prefetch=false` — watching.

incident-bot: Action logged: kv-prefetch disabled on gpu-pool-a by Priya Reddy.

Samir Patel: Checking node-level memory maps. Found large resident set from `runner_p80` processes: RSS growth after every request. suspect leak in kv-cache cleanup path after prefetch eviction.

Alex Chen: Rolling restart of affected runners (graceful): `for node in gpu-a03 gpu-a04 gpu-a05 gpu-a06; do ssh $node sudo systemctl restart runner; done` — starting now, will drain first.

Lee (oncall): Initiated routing rule to send 20% of traffic off gpu-pool-a to cpu-fallback and 30% to gpu-pool-b. Command: `routerctl set-weight pool=gpu-pool-a weight=0.5 pool=gpu-pool-b weight=0.3 pool=cpu-fallback weight=0.2`

Alex Chen: Restarts in progress. gpu-a03 restarted, gpu-a04 restart failed to come up (OOM at startup), holding.

Samir Patel: For gpu-a04 I see kernel dmesg entries: `[   12.345678] NVRM: GPU: Unable to allocate memory, error 2 (no memory)` and `cuda: failed to create context`. Might need node reboot.

Priya Reddy: Rebooting gpu-a04 (coordinated) — marking maintenance.

Maria S.: Customer impact note: Escalated to Customer Success for high-volume tenant X-Prime, they reported timeouts. CS ticket 54872 created.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98231 status -> acknowledged by Alex Chen.

Alex Chen: After restarts and routing change, 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% within 3m. Still elevated but improving. Keeping page active until stable.

Samir Patel: Investigating root cause: reproducer shows kvcache not freeing GPU pages after eviction when prefetch fails and `cudaFree` returns success but nvml shows retained allocations. Suspect race in background eviction thread.

Priya Reddy: Captured core logs and heap profiles: `s3://redwood-debug/gpu-oom/4751117777/` (shared with infra).

Alex Chen: For immediate safety, enabling a hard per-runner GPU memory cap: `rlctl runner set gpu_mem_limit=45GB` for p80-runner on pool-a and pool-b to prevent runaway.

Lee (oncall): Applying cap on pool-b as well to avoid ripple. Notifying SRE to watch autoscale.

infra-bot: Created infra ticket INF-3259: investigate kvcache eviction leak on CUDA 12.2 drivers. Assigned to Samir Patel.

Maria S.: Noting customer comms: CS draft — short explanation + ETA to restore full capacity ~2h, include mitigation steps and AP impact. Approving.

Alex Chen: Current status summary for PD: mitigations applied (prefetch disabled, runner restarts, routing weights adjusted, gpu node rebooted), partial recovery (5xx from 9% -> 2.1%), ongoing work: root cause triage, infra ticket INF-3259, customer comms. Will update every 15m.

Priya Reddy: Logging for handoff: I'm taking next shift oncall in 20m; will monitor and be ready to escalate if error rate >3% or OOMs resume.

Samir Patel: Found suspected regression in recent kvcache commit that touched allocator free path. Reproduced leak locally with stress harness. Preparing hotfix branch, will push patch and candidate build for canary in 40m.

Lee (oncall): If hotfix is validated, plan: canary deploy to gpu-pool-b (20% traffic) then promote. If not, keep prefetched disabled and maintain routing.

incident-bot: PD-98231 annotated with mitigations and linked INF-3259, CS-54872.

Alex Chen: Thanks team. continuing monitoring. tagging @pagerduty for timeline update.

PagerDuty: Noted. Will keep PD active and await resolution updates.

Maria S.: I'll post initial customer note in 10m.

Priya Reddy: Handoff: Priya will be primary contact after Alex signs off; Alex -> Priya in 18m.

Alex Chen: Handing off to Priya in 18m. Ending active typing, will remain reachable.

Samir Patel: pushing PR `fix/kvcache-free-leak` now.

Lee (oncall): Good work. Keep monitoring latency and token throughput metrics. If OOMs return, PD escalate to infra lead.

incident-bot: Last update logged. Thread will remain open until PD cleared.
